column1: # Terraform, OpenTofu and Terragrunt counters (.tf, .hcl), for a rule with the prompt file-body-ops:
# one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks, leftmost region first, #
# and // comments, block comments, heredocs (<<EOF and <<-EOF up to the marker alone on its line)
# and string literals, so a "resource" in a description, a policy document or a comment does not
# count; a block comment or a heredoc that is never closed runs to the end of the file. A string
# with an interpolation that holds a quote ("${x == "a"}") ends at that quote, as a regex reads it.
# A block counts by its keyword at the start of a line, not an attribute of that name (provider =
# aws.west) nor a reference on a line of its own (module.network, data.aws_ami.base in a depends_on
# list); "count and for_each" counts both meta-arguments; "refactoring blocks" moved, import and
# removed. OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every
